tools.name: Desk__cancel
tools.description:
Cancel an order.

rpc Desk::cancel of Orders: returns Ticket. Requires no role; the server still authorizes every request.

tools.name: Desk__count
tools.description: rpc Desk::count of Orders: returns Int. Requires no role; the server still authorizes every request.

tools.name: Desk__place
tools.description:
Place an order.
It is filled at the limit or better; a desk that is closed refuses it.

rpc Desk::place of Orders: returns Receipt; its failure is the handler error OrderError. Requires clerk under the exposure's role source; the server still authorizes every request.

limit.description: An amount of money, counted in cents.

notes.authorization: requires is checked against this exposure's role source at the serve site, before a request is queued: a boundary check, never a proof over the program's internal call paths
notes.lifecycle: a request accepted runs to completion: a timeout or a lost connection does not mean it did not run, and ending the wait never rolls it back
